notes: Mobile Harness Code v1.23.0 — Deno runtime, a new optional developer stack. Adds Deno (MIT, v2.9.8 ARM64) installed on demand from the official release with SHA-256 verification, with independent Install / Enable / Disable / Remove controls (the /usr/local/bin/deno symlink is the enable switch, so the binary can stay installed while disabled and never idles on CPU/RAM). The module cache is never deleted on Disable/Remove — a separate confirmed Clear-cache action handles DENO_DIR. PluginRuntimeDetection no longer misreports bun/bunx as needing Node.js/npm. Bun is excluded because its binary statically links LGPL-2.0/2.1 code. No new Gradle dependencies. Signed (V2) with the unchanged production certificate.
